results.title: Excise Officers Assaulted During Liquor Raid in Mayurbhanj, 4 Arrested
results.description: ମଦ ରେଡ୍ ବେଳେ ଅବକାରୀ ଅଧିକାରୀଙ୍କୁ ମାଡ଼। କଲର୍ ଧରିଲେ, ଟଣାଓଟରା କଲେ ଓ ମାଡ଼ ମାରିଲେ। ମୟୂରଭଞ୍ଜ ଜିଲ୍ଲା କରଞ୍ଜିଆ ଉପଖଣ୍ଡ ଚଢ଼େଇଭୋଳ ନିକଟରେ ଘଟିଛି ଏହି ଘଟଣା। ଘଟଣାର ଭିଡିଓ ଭାଇରାଲ ପରେ ପୋଲିସର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନୁଷ୍ଠାନ। #OdishaCrime #Mayurbhanj #Karanjia #ExciseRaid #PoliceAction #IllegalLiquor #OdishaNews #OdishaTV #OTV Excise officials were allegedly assaulted during a raid against illegal liquor trading at a dhaba near Chadhaibhol under Karanjia subdivision in Mayurbhanj district. The officials had reached the dhaba near National Highway 49 to check allegations of illegal liquor trading and reportedly found a large quantity of liquor and empty bottles.
